_summary: Read in full on 2026-10-07: the live prompt after #24 (fees as fee × (entry + stop)), all 30 cases, 40 s apart, the first of the fresh live baseline. 20 of 30 automatically. On a read, 13 errors, none critical: 11 major, 2 minor. p-size is to the cent at the desk's figures (1.621583): #24 holds, and run 20's critical is gone. The majors are run 20's kinds: figures and firm rules from no tool (ex-r, b-limits, s-firm), wrong rules or figures (b-leverage's 10× on the 1-Step and Bitfunded's 'cross margin', p-assets with no TSLA, o-montecarlo's 0.5%, s-product's 'lower total target', d-stock), the retired local hours (p-reset-local), the ladder misdated (p-ladder-instant), news pointed to the firm's documents (o-news). $0.8103 on the eval key.
